Worktree: `objectstack-issue-30932`
Domain: `domain:devx`
Seat: `domain:devx#2`
File surface:
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`: a required `origin: generic | customer-derived | held-out`, and the card title becomes `{ zh, en }`.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`: refuses a card with no origin, and refuses a `generic` card that lives in the private overlay.
- The nine open-library cards in `docs/qa/scenarios/`: each gets its origin and both titles.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/generic.ts` and `exporter.ts`: the guard reads `origin === 'generic'` in place of `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`, and the index fills `title.zh`.
- Every reader of the card title (runner, prompts, scorecard, export), and the tests under `packages/qa/scenarios/test/`.
- Plus whatever pin or self-test a gate derives from those files.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: n/a — QA tooling (the scenario card format); independent contract review before ACCEPT
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds. At `origin/main` `5f00374492`:
- `schema.ts:482` is still `title: z.string().min(1)`, and there is no origin field.
- `exporter.ts:189` still defaults to `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`.
- The `tier` field (#30970) is already in `schema.ts` (`SCENARIO_TIERS`), so the export filter composes `tier ∈ {starter, delivery}` with `origin === 'generic'`.
Serial constraints cleared: #30846 has landed, and no open PR touches `packages/qa/scenarios` or `docs/qa/scenarios`. #30913 is on hold awaiting a ruling (a `personas[].record` field on the same schema), so it is not in flight. Taken ahead of its p3 grade because it blocks #31121 and #31122, the D2 write path of p1 #30349.
